scheme_name: Nirman Shramik Siksha Kaushal Vikas Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be the son, daughter, or wife of a registered construction worker in the Rajasthan Welfare Board.
A maximum of two children of the registered worker (or one child and the wife) can receive the scholarship; if both husband and wife are registered, up to two children of the couple are eligible.
The wife of the beneficiary must be ≤35 years old and must be studying regularly in an educational institution.
The student must be regularly enrolled in a government or recognized private school/college (class 6 to postgraduate) or in a recognized ITI/polytechnic in the state.
The beneficiary must have deposited contributions continuously for at least one year; lapse leads to loss of eligibility, which can be restored as per rules.
Scholarship is payable only after passing the relevant examination for the year, and admission to the next class is required except when the final examination is passed.
benefits_summary: Scholarships ranging from ₹8,000 to ₹25,000 per year are provided based on the education level, along with cash awards for meritorious students.
